review:
A retro fruit slot with reels permanently on fire – 10 lines, glowing symbols, flame animations.

Wilds only land on the third reel, and when they're part of a win they expand over the whole reel for more wins. No complicated bonus. Low volatility, a 2,500x max and an excellent 97.21% RTP. Fast, simple and easy on the balance.
pros: Excellent 97.21% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
